items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: I talked to Eddie Barefield quite a bit about it, and Eddie was telling me... I got to talking with Eddie one day... Eddie told me that it seemed like Wallace Bishop's house was a place that musicians knew to go

ctx.x: Yeah, we had a piano. Piano, drums, guitar and C-melody. And later on, another fellow came from St. Paul, and his name was Art. Barefield told me his name, because Barefield know him. Art. And he played more saxophone than I did. So that's when I cocked my ears. I started picking up on what he was doing, and I started playing the same things. We even played little duets.
